Computation 4.9 decomposes the spatial–spatial rank-at-most-five leg-coefficient locus into seven classes. Their (number,dimension,degree) are (15,30,1), (40,28,3), (15,27,72), (30,26,3), (12,26,444), (1,26,8445), and (2,25,924). The classes are described by coincidences, collinearities, coplanarities, or planar–planar anchor arrangements. Such rank deficiency supplies algebraically dependent leg constraints; consistent lengths can admit positive-dimensional configuration fibres.
scope: Spatial–spatial anchor data whose 6×16 Segre leg-coefficient matrix has rank≤5.
